name: tnf
description:
TNF CLI - Unified Command Surface for TNF Operations

🔑 Super Admin Authentication:
  Certain restricted commands require a Super Admin token.
  You must set the TNF_SUPER_ADMIN_TOKEN in your environment as the master secret.
  To authenticate a command, you can:
    - Use the --super-admin-token <token> flag
    - Set the TNF_SUPER_ADMIN_INPUT_TOKEN environment variable
    - Set the CI_SUPER_ADMIN_TOKEN environment variable (for CI/CD)
